title: Concept: Dynamic code compilation via Function constructor in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, new Function() turns a string into code. Unlike eval it always compiles in global scope and cannot see local closures, but that does not make it safe: whatever reaches the argument executes with full access to the window, network and storage. Feature flags, formula builders and rule engines are the usual places where user text reaches this constructor.
applicability: javascript browser or Node.js code that evaluates user-supplied expressions.
risk: Arbitrary script execution in the application origin; HIGH severity.
